title: SOH CAH TOA: what sine, cosine and tangent mean
examples: What does SOH CAH TOA mean?
What is sine in a right-angled triangle?

items.label: Hypotenuse: 5
items.ask: What is the hypotenuse of a right triangle?

explain.say: Take a right-angled triangle with sides 3, 4 and 5. Pick one of the small angles and call it theta, a Greek letter. Each side gets a name, depending on where it sits compared with theta. Look at the three bars.

draw.text: SOH CAH TOA: what sine, cosine and tangent mean

items.label: Hypotenuse: 5
items.ask: What is the hypotenuse of a right triangle?

explain.say: The side across from theta is the opposite: 3. The side right next to theta is the adjacent, which means next to: 4. And the longest side, across from the right angle, is the hypotenuse: 5. Which name never changes?

items.label: Hypotenuse: 5
items.ask: What is the hypotenuse of a right triangle?

explain.say: The hypotenuse! Now for the ratios. SOH means sine is opposite over hypotenuse. Here that is 3 over 5, which is 0.6. Look at the SOH group.

groups.label: SOH: sine
groups.ask: What does SOH CAH TOA stand for?

groups.label: TOA: tangent
groups.ask: Why are the ratios the same for every triangle with that angle?

explain.say: CAH means cosine is adjacent over hypotenuse: 4 over 5, which is 0.8. And TOA means tangent is opposite over adjacent: 3 over 4, which is 0.75. Can you say SOH CAH TOA out loud?

groups.label: TOA: tangent
groups.ask: Why are the ratios the same for every triangle with that angle?

explain.say: Brilliant! Here is the magic: every right triangle with the same angle has the same ratios, because they are similar triangles. Wow: this angle is about 37 degrees, and every calculator knows its sine is 0.6. Challenge: in a 5, 12, 13 triangle, what is the tangent of the angle opposite 5?

faq.a: The side directly across from the angle you are using. In the 3, 4, 5 triangle it is the side of 3.
Adjacent means next to. It is the side beside the angle that is not the hypotenuse. Here it is the side of 4.

faq.q: What is the hypotenuse of a right triangle?
faq.a: The longest side, opposite the right angle. It stays the same whichever small angle you pick.
asks: Which side is the hypotenuse in trigonometry?

faq.q: What does SOH CAH TOA stand for?
faq.a: Sine is opposite over hypotenuse, cosine is adjacent over hypotenuse, and tangent is opposite over adjacent.

faq.q: Why are the ratios the same for every triangle with that angle?
faq.a: Right triangles with the same angle are similar, so their sides grow in the same ratio. Dividing one side by another always gives the same number.

facts: In a 3-4-5 triangle, the angle opposite the side of 3 is about 36.9°, with sine 0.6, cosine 0.8 and tangent 0.75.
The word sine comes, through Latin, from translations of the Sanskrit word jya used by Indian astronomers.

quiz.say: In a right triangle the opposite side is 6 and the hypotenuse is 10. What is the sine of the angle?
quiz.why: Sine is opposite over hypotenuse: 6 divided by 10 is 0.6.

wrong.1: 0.8 would be the cosine, using the adjacent side of 8.

quiz.say: Which ratio uses the opposite and adjacent sides?
quiz.why: TOA: tangent is opposite over adjacent.
